messages.en: My head's a mess today. I've got so much on my mind.
Just take a break first. I'm here if you want to talk.

senses.en_definition: A small, usually rectangular piece of stiff paper or plastic, used to carry information, identify someone, make payments, or serve other purposes.

messages.en: Hi, can I pay by card here? I haven't got any cash on me.
Yes, we take debit cards too. Just pay at the counter when you're ready.
Yeah, I just got home. Are you still at the shop?
I'm planning to get married at the end of this year.
Wow, congratulations! Have you picked a date yet?
